title: AION 2 Codes: Rewards and Redemption
description: Redeem AION 2 codes, see coupon rewards and account limits, and fix common redemption errors.
summary: Redeem the coupon in the right menu before its expiry. One use per account across all servers.
quickAnswer: Redeem the listed coupon in Settings → Miscellaneous → Account → Enter Coupon. NC allows one redemption per account across all servers; check the coupon card’s deadline before claiming.

toc.title: Claim the other launch rewards separately

topic.alt: Three reward icons for the coupon.
topic.caption: Coupon rewards.

workflow.title: Choose the correct reward route
workflow.caption: A coupon, an inbox gift, and a Twitch Drop have separate claiming methods.

steps.label: Identify the reward
steps.description: Identify whether you are claiming a coupon, inbox gift or Twitch Drop.

steps.label: Open its claim entry
steps.description: Use Enter Coupon for the code, the in-game inbox for the gift, or Twitch inventory for a Drop.

steps.label: Check the recipient
steps.description: Use your playing account. The coupon allowance is one redemption per account across all servers.

steps.label: Read the result
steps.description: Check the client or Twitch claim result before repeating the action; keep the exact error if help is needed.
